mapper.insert: insert ignore into coop_group_verify (topic_id, activity_id, coop_order_id, merchant_member_id, leader_member_id, verify_time) values (#{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{coopOrderId}, #{merchantMemberId}, #{leaderMemberId}, #{verifyTime})
mapper.select: select verify.id as verificationId, verify.topic_id as topicId, verify.activity_id as activityId, topic.name as topicName, verify.coop_order_id as coopOrderId, verify.merchant_member_id as merchantMemberId, coalesce(nullif(merchant.nickname, ''), nullif(merchant.name, ''), concat('成员#', verify.merchant_member_id)) as merchantDisplayName, verify.leader_member_id as leaderMemberId, coalesce(nullif(leader.nickname, ''), nullif(leader.name, ''), concat('成员#', verify.leader_member_id)) as leaderDisplayName, verify.verify_time as verifyTime from coop_group_verify verify inner join cms_activity ca on verify.activity_id = ca.id and verify.topic_id = ca.topic_id and ca.del_flag = 0 inner join club on club.id = ca.club_id and club.del_flag = 0 inner join cms_topic topic on topic.id = ca.topic_id and topic.del_flag = 0 left join ums_member merchant on merchant.id = verify.merchant_member_id and merchant.del_flag = 0 left join ums_member leader on leader.id = verify.leader_member_id and leader.del_flag = 0 where ca.club_id = #{clubId} and exists ( select 1 from coop_order co where co.topic_id = ca.topic_id and co.to_type = 'club' and co.to_id = ca.club_id and co.status = 0 and co.del_flag = 0 ) order by verify.verify_time desc, verify.id desc
